question: Who won a bronze medal at the U23 Asian Wrestling Championships in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepak Punia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Deepak Punia won a bronze medal at the U23 Asian Wrestling Championships in 2022.

 
• **Deepak Punia's Achievement:** Deepak Punia, a prominent Indian wrestler, secured a bronze medal in the 86kg freestyle category at the U23 Asian Wrestling Championships held in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan in 2022.
 
• **Background:** Punia is a highly accomplished wrestler, having won a silver medal at the senior world championships and represented India at the Tokyo Olympics.
 
• **Performance at the Championship:** Although a bronze medal was perhaps below his own high expectations, it was still a commendable achievement at a continental championship.
 
• **Other Indian Medal Winners:** India had a successful outing at the 2022 U23 Asian Wrestling Championships, winning a total of 25 medals, including 10 gold, 8 silver, and 7 bronze medals.
 
• **Indian Wrestling Contingent:** The Indian contingent consisted of wrestlers across various weight categories in freestyle, Greco-Roman, and women's wrestling.
 
• **Freestyle Category:** In men's freestyle wrestling, along with Deepak Punia's bronze, India won several gold medals in other weight categories.
 
• **Greco-Roman Category:** Indian wrestlers also performed well in the Greco-Roman category, securing gold, silver, and bronze medals.
